findings.evidence: The declaration body is exactly `isCyclic_stabilizer G tau`, and `rg` finds no consumer outside its own declaration/docstring.
findings.fix: Delete the wrapper and use `Subgroup.isCyclic_stabilizer G tau` directly at consumers.
findings.issue: `isCyclic_stabilizer_of_discrete` is an unused thin specialization of `Subgroup.isCyclic_stabilizer`; typeclass inference supplies the finite stabilizer instance.

findings.evidence: Lines 212–221 merely apply `UpperHalfPlane.isElliptic_of_exists_smul_eq_self`; `rg` finds no consumer outside this declaration/docstring.
findings.fix: Delete it and apply `UpperHalfPlane.isElliptic_of_exists_smul_eq_self`, translating projective nonidentity with `QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff` and `toGL_mem_center_iff` at the eventual consumer.
findings.issue: `isElliptic_of_smul_eq_self_of_mk_ne_one` is an unused specialization of Mathlib's `UpperHalfPlane.isElliptic_of_exists_smul_eq_self`.

summary: Two unused specialization wrappers duplicate existing declarations instead of exposing genuinely new API.
